title: Fix two layout notes and show a Demo viewer an alias instead of the sample name?
bluf: Three small display calls. Table scroll after PR #241: the extra width stays inside the scroll region; accept it. Text links under 44 px high on customer pages: make them 44 px. A Demo viewer sees 'Quollridge Logistics (sample)' on Home and a customer page: use the alias, as the security pages do. Default if you do not tap: option A, Tuesday queues it for the build lanes, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-401, HPSMPOC-417, HPSMPOC-410

options.label: Accept scroll; 44 px links; use the alias

default_action: Option A: queue for the web lane; nothing deployed.
